Definition: A validation-local machine-readable artifact whose OpenMath formulas are evaluated and compared against OPS results.
A value carrying a Decimal, unit, dimension tuple, and dimension name.
A (length, force) integer-exponent tuple identifying a physical dimension.
SHA-256 over the witness serialized as canonical JSON with sorted keys and compact separators.
Exception raised when a formal witness is invalid or generated artifacts are stale.
External result envelope of OPS result_sets compared against witness formula values.
Per-output absolute tolerance bounding the allowed delta between witness and OPS values.
OpenMath content dictionary of supported arithmetic operators (plus, minus, times, divide, power).
MathML document rendered from witness OpenMath formulas with id and SHA-256 attributes.
